repair.title: Declared Chemical Weapons Were Destroyed
repair.summary: In 2023, OPCW verified that all declared chemical weapons stockpiles had been irreversibly destroyed.
repair.why_it_matters: Treaties, inspections, and patient destruction work removed a class of weapons built for mass suffering.
repair.caveat: Undeclared weapons, alleged use, and toxic industrial chemicals remain serious risks.
repair.source_name: Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons
